perf.reverify_note: anthropic>anthropic is a same-dialect cell: there is no translation to prove, so a request-shape check upstream cannot distinguish a translating gateway from a forwarding one
perf.c1_note: the c=1 percentiles are taken over 51089 successful gateway round trip(s) and 232954 direct-to-mock round trip(s), each leg a single clean window with no failures

stream.stream_c1_note: the c=1 streaming legs read 64 frame(s) through the gateway and 64 direct to the mock, out of a 64 frame budget; the added-gap figures are medians over the intervals between those frames, and the p99 fields are absent because one stream cannot support a 99th percentile

memory.protocol: cold restart, idle read at rest, then load at c=32 in repeated windows until the              trailing 60s is flat (cap 300s), then 60s with the load removed

stream.added_gap_p99_us.detail: the gateway's own inter-frame gap at this percentile (21132us) came in under the mock's (21134us), which a proxy cannot really do - the added gap here is below what this rig can resolve against the mock's 20ms pacing
